Symptoms range from acute urticaria (most common) to flushing to angioedema to exacerbations of atopic dermatitis. Food allergy is rarely the cause of chronic urticaria or angioedema. Atopic dermatitis Controversy surrounds the role of food allergy in the pathogenesis of atopic dermatitis. Food-specific IgE-mediated and cellular mechanisms appear responsible for chronic eczematous inflammation.
